{launch(Probe, M, D) : month(M), destination(D)} = 1 :- probe(Probe).

% No option in any category will ever be used more than once.
{P1=P2; M1=M2; D1=D2}=0 :- launch(P1, M1, D1), launch(P2, M2, D2), (P1,M1,D1)!=(P2,M2,D2).

% 1. The Iunsel launched in February.
M=2 :- launch(P, M, D), P="Iunsel".

% 2. The Munei is going to Mars.
D="Mars" :- launch(P, M, D), P="Munei".

% 3. The Munei launched 1 month after the mission going to Pluto.
M = M2 + 1 :- launch("Munei", M, "Mars"), launch(P2, M2, "Pluto").

% 4.2 The mission going to Ganymede launched in March or is the Chano.
{M=3; P="Chano"}=1 :- launch(P, M, "Ganymede").

% 4.3 The mission going to Pluto launched in March or is the Chano.
{M=3; P="Chano"}=1 :- launch(P, M, "Pluto").
